description: Contract for a single resolved wave partition (wind sea or swell system).

direction_var.description: Variable name for wave propagation direction in degrees [0, 360).
direction_var.title: Direction Var

directional_spreading_var.description: Variable name for directional spreading width in degrees.
directional_spreading_var.title: Directional Spreading Var

partition_index.description: Zero-based index of the partition (0 for total/primary).
partition_index.title: Partition Index

peak_or_mean_period_var.description: Variable name for wave period (s) (peak Tp or mean Tm).
peak_or_mean_period_var.title: Peak Or Mean Period Var

significant_wave_height_var.description: Variable name for significant wave height Hs (m).
significant_wave_height_var.title: Significant Wave Height Var

title: WavePartitionContract
